title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student provides the correct expression for the potential energy W.

title: Electric Field Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student correctly derives the electric field E from the bound surface charge density.

title: Force Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student accurately calculates the force F acting on the point charge.

title: Integration Setup
description: Important Criteria: The student sets up the integral correctly to find the potential energy W.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student makes a sign mistake in the expression for the potential energy W.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student checks that the units of the final answer for W are consistent.

title: Boundary Conditions
description: Important Criteria: The student applies the boundary conditions correctly to relate E1 and E2.
